final: WITH telescope_avg AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as baseline1 FROM telescope_avg), filtered_once AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse FROM telescope_avg ta, first_baseline fb WHERE ta.avg_pulse > fb.baseline1), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as baseline2 FROM filtered_once), final_filtered AS (SELECT fo.avg_pulse FROM filtered_once fo, second_baseline sb WHERE fo.avg_pulse > sb.baseline2), fb AS (SELECT baseline1 FROM first_baseline LIMIT 1), sb AS (SELECT baseline2 FROM second_baseline LIMIT 1) SELECT AVG(ff.avg_pulse) as mean_of_averages, AVG(ff.avg_pulse - fb.baseline1) as mean_excess_over_first, AVG(ff.avg_pulse - sb.baseline2) as mean_excess_over_second FROM final_filtered ff, fb, sb
